description: Final step: Regenerate BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx with all changes, validate XML, verify all new sources are embedded, and commit everything.
steps: Step 1 - Run python tools/generate_rbxlx.py from the project root to regenerate BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx with all source changes.
Step 2 - Validate XML well-formedness: python -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; ET.parse('BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx'); print('XML valid')"
Step 3 - Verify that DailyRewardService source appears in the .rbxlx: grep for 'DailyRewardService' in the .rbxlx file.
Step 4 - Verify that _critTokens/critToken logic appears in the .rbxlx (embedded ZoneService source).
Step 5 - Verify that _eggPromptConnections appears in the .rbxlx (embedded Main.client source).
Step 6 - Check git diff to confirm all expected changes are present. Stage and commit with a clear message like 'feat: P0/P1 bug fixes + daily rewards system'.
acceptance_criteria: All new Lua source files are embedded in the .rbxlx
Git commit created with all changes
